description: Source code implementing an AVL Tree node class with methods for insertion, deletion, rotation, cloning, and searching, including template specializations and conditional compilation for different data types and debugging.

classes.name: AVLNode
classes.description: Template class representing a node in an AVL tree with methods for balancing, insertion, deletion, and traversal.

methods.name: operator new
methods.description: Allocates memory for a new AVLNode using zmalloc.

methods.name: operator delete
methods.description: Frees memory of an AVLNode using zfree.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the node and its children.

methods.name: SetParent
methods.description: Recursively sets parent pointers for the node and its children.

methods.name: RotateOnce
methods.description: Performs a single rotation (left or right) to rebalance the tree.

methods.name: RotateTwice
methods.description: Performs a double rotation for rebalancing.

methods.name: ReBalance
methods.description: Rebalances the node if it is unbalanced, performing rotations as needed.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new node into the AVL tree, maintaining balance.

methods.name: Found
methods.description: Checks if a key matches the node's key based on the specified mode.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a node with the specified key, rebalancing the tree.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Searches for a node with the given key.

methods.name: Sort
methods.description: Performs an in-order traversal to sort nodes into an array.
